entries.name: Danger Desensitization
entries.summary: You prepare a trained or trusting animal to function around one frightening stimulus such as fire, battle noise, monsters, crowds, or magic without forcing it through unlimited terror.

entries.name: Darkness Field
entries.summary: You thicken shadows into a tactical zone that dims sight, hides movement, and unsettles those inside. Use this to break line of sight, isolate enemies, cover retreat, or control a passage.

entries.name: Dawn Bridge
entries.summary: You create a temporary negotiating space where hostile people can speak without immediately losing face or status. Use this to halt escalation long enough to exchange terms, establish one shared interest, or keep a fragile meeting from collapsing.

entries.name: Dawn Purge
entries.summary: Concentrate solar heat and revelation into a cleansing burst that strips away one nearby layer of corruption, supernatural darkness, false radiance, infection-like magical taint, or concealment. It exposes and burns what the Sun Arcana can actually reach rather than solving every curse.

entries.name: Dawn Ward
entries.summary: You surround one target with warm solar light that resists cold, shadow pressure, fear, and minor corruption while revealing obvious darkness clinging to them.

entries.name: Dawnrunner
entries.summary: You run with legendary endurance and route instinct, crossing distance like a messenger from myth. Can arrive in time for a critical scene when the route is physically possible but would break ordinary travelers.

entries.name: Daybreak Expanse
entries.summary: You fill a major scene with controlled magical daylight, glare, refraction, and searing lines of radiance. It can deny darkness and pressure many foes at once, but broad coverage reduces precision.

entries.name: Daybreak Lance
entries.summary: You compress light into a focused line of searing brilliance. Use this to strike a target, burn away magical darkness, blind a dangerous foe, cut through shadowed concealment, or force light-sensitive creatures into retreat.

entries.name: Daystar
entries.summary: You manifest overwhelming solar authority as a crown, aura, beam, or field of radiant judgment. Use this to cleanse major corruption, repel supernatural darkness, strengthen allies through solar resolve, expose concealed taint or shadowed magic, or make a battlefield answer to daylight.

entries.name: Dead Reckoning
entries.summary: You reconstruct your approximate position from the last reliable point, travel time, heading, terrain, slope, water, and weather after landmarks are lost. It can recover a plausible route or expose accumulated drift, but cannot reveal ground you have never observed.

entries.name: Death Mark
entries.summary: Study a target movement, habits, armor, and fear until one lethal opening becomes clear. Bypasses ordinary guard on a prepared strike against a vulnerable target.

entries.name: Death Sense
entries.summary: You recognize the nearness, trace, or wrongness of death before others can name it. Use this to sense recent death, undead presence, lethal curses, dying bodies, grave magic, or places where life has been unnaturally thinned.

entries.name: Death's Threshold
entries.summary: You seize temporary control of the boundary between life and death around a critical target or scene. You may delay a death, sever necromantic influence, or force an undead presence toward stillness, but you cannot casually restore the truly dead.

entries.name: Deathless Interval
entries.summary: Hold a dying creature at the threshold between life and death for a short crisis, preventing immediate passage while treatment, escape, or a final act remains possible. This does not heal the injury, restore the dead, or make the target safe once the interval ends.

entries.name: Deathroom Rewrite
entries.summary: Reconfigure a lethal trap chamber so its own logic creates a safe path, false trigger, or controlled release. Turns an extreme hazard into a usable advantage if it is not purely magical will.

entries.name: Deathtrap Rewrite
entries.summary: You seize a trap's mechanism, purpose, and timing so completely that it becomes your tool. Use this to reverse a legendary trap, weaponize it against enemies, preserve its useful parts, or turn a death mechanism into protection.

entries.name: Deathward
entries.summary: You brace a living target against death-state magic, life drain, corpse influence, or the supernatural pull of a dying threshold. It delays or resists such pressure but does not heal ordinary wounds.

entries.name: Deathward Surgery
entries.summary: You perform a complex intervention on a critically injured patient while managing blood loss, shock, poison, breathing, and secondary damage together. Use this to keep a patient alive through an injury that ordinary first aid cannot stabilize; success still depends on tools, time, and the injury.

entries.name: Debt of Compliments
entries.summary: Make a favor feel like proper repayment after publicly praising, defending, legitimizing, or socially rescuing someone. Turns public praise or rescue into a soft obligation.

entries.name: Decisive Arc
entries.summary: You turn one opening into a masterful sequence of Dueling-family weapon strikes, footwork, feints, and pressure. Use this to overwhelm a powerful opponent or move through several nearby threats; other weapon families and unarmed attacks remain governed by their own skills.

entries.name: Decisive Command
entries.summary: Identify the one coordinated action that can turn a battle, rout, rescue, or defense and drive allies to execute it together. Greatly improves a single group action that depends on discipline and trust.

entries.name: Deckline Footwork
entries.summary: Use rails, lines, mast positions, deck motion, and rigging clearance as part of close combat on a vessel. It keeps you functional while the deck moves and can create a quick reposition when shipboard terrain supports it.

facts.label: Requirements
facts.value: Mariner Combatant 1, Sail Handling 30, Light Blades 30

entries.name: Deep Ore Revelation
entries.summary: You recognize the deeper pattern beneath stone, mineral traces, tunnel supports, and worked ground. Use this to locate valuable deposits, identify unstable underground areas, or reveal hidden mining routes.

entries.name: Defensive Brace
entries.summary: Lock your stance behind shield, armor, or cover before impact lands. Reduces the chance of being shoved, knocked down, or driven from a defended position.

entries.name: Deny the Lane
entries.summary: Establish a guarded arc that makes crossing one approach immediately dangerous, forcing ordinary opponents to slow, divert, or risk being checked. It controls a plausible lane rather than an entire battlefield.

entries.name: Depth Pressure
entries.summary: You press abyssal weight into a target or area, making motion heavy, light dim, breath tighten, and courage falter. Use this to slow enemies, suppress an advance, darken a corridor, weaken morale, or create crushing depth.

entries.name: Depth Step
entries.summary: You wrap yourself in the sensation of impossible depth, muffling sound and making nearby observers misjudge your distance or vertical position for a brief movement.

entries.name: Detail Focus
entries.summary: You deliberately lock attention onto small visual inconsistencies such as scratches, stains, seams, motion, or altered placement that casual observation would miss.

entries.name: Device Recognition
entries.summary: You recognize common arms, badges, livery, rank marks, cadency, or heraldic conventions and know when a displayed device is obviously inconsistent.

entries.name: Devouring Focus
entries.summary: Concentrate supernatural hunger onto one chosen source of effort, heat, magic, nourishment, or vitality that you can meaningfully reach, draining its available strength into temporary relief or pressure. The effect cannot consume abstract concepts without an established magical connection.

entries.name: Devouring Touch
entries.summary: You draw stamina, warmth, magical charge, or another coherent form of usable energy from one contacted target or object. What you take depends on what is actually present and the target can resist.

entries.name: Diagnostic Interview
entries.summary: You turn symptoms, timing, diet, exposure, pain, and medical history into a structured differential rather than guessing from the most obvious sign.

entries.name: Dim Veil
entries.summary: Draw nearby shadow around your outline and soften the signs of your movement. Makes casual sight-based detection unreliable in dim or broken light.

entries.name: Diplomatic Opening
entries.summary: Establish a formal diplomatic framing for a conversation - signal intent to negotiate in good faith, invoke protocol, or create a brief window where hostility is socially untenable.

entries.name: Direct Order
entries.summary: Issue a clear, authoritative command that produces immediate compliance from those predisposed to follow orders. Works on soldiers, servants, and people in structured roles under stress.

entries.name: Directional Listen
entries.summary: You isolate the rough direction of a faint sound through noise, echo, or obstruction, helping locate footsteps, speech, machinery, animals, or movement.

entries.name: Dirty Opening
entries.summary: Use a shoulder bump, low kick, sleeve pull, headbutt, or thrown dust to disrupt an opponent rhythm. Creates advantage for an immediate close-range follow-up.

entries.name: Disarming Line
entries.summary: Control the opponent weapon hand, balance, or angle long enough to strip away their advantage. Can disarm, bind, or neutralize a mundane weapon guard on success.

entries.name: Disarming Performance
entries.summary: Command attention so strongly through performance that tension drops, enemies hesitate, or a crowd gives room to act. Temporarily shifts the emotional pressure of a scene.

entries.name: Disaster Command
entries.summary: You command crew, controls, engines, and conditions through a disaster as one system. Can keep a damaged craft operational long enough to finish the scene.

entries.name: Disease Thief
entries.summary: Draw a bounded disease, magical blight, fever-pattern, or spreading corruption out of one target and contain it temporarily in yourself, a prepared vessel, or sacrificial medium. The disease is transferred or contained, not simply erased, and mishandling remains dangerous.

entries.name: Displacement
entries.summary: You fold space for a short visible jump, moving yourself, a willing target, or a contested nearby target to a place you can clearly see. The distortion is visible at both points and cannot pass unknown barriers safely.

entries.name: Disrupting Volley
entries.summary: Shoot to break casting focus, command rhythm, reload timing, or charge momentum. Interrupts one vulnerable action if the arrow lands cleanly.

entries.name: Dissolution Bloom
entries.summary: You release a powerful corrosive bloom across a limited target or area, turning acid into a battlefield hazard, armor-breaker, barrier-eater, or monster-burning surge. It must remain contained and can endanger allies, supplies, floors, and structures.

entries.name: Distance Read
entries.summary: You judge identity, equipment, posture, banners, movement, or terrain detail at long visual range more reliably than ordinary sight conditions allow.

entries.name: Doctrinal Arbitration
entries.summary: You compare competing interpretations, precedents, and ritual obligations to identify where a religious dispute genuinely hinges and what recognized authorities might accept.

entries.name: Doctrine of Restraint
entries.summary: Challenge zealots, frightened mobs, or reckless officers by citing accepted duty, doctrine, law, or moral obligation without sounding rebellious. Checks zealotry, panic, or reckless command through recognized doctrine or duty.

entries.name: Document Chain
entries.summary: You reconstruct who created, copied, approved, amended, transmitted, and stored a set of records, helping expose gaps, substitutions, or suspicious changes in custody.

entries.name: Dominating Presence
entries.summary: Your gaze, voice, stillness, and supernatural hunger press on a weaker will. Use this to intimidate, hold attention, command hesitation, lure someone closer, or impose social pressure, but it cannot override firm loyalty, clear consent, magical protection, or someone with stronger will and reason to resist.

entries.name: Doom Echo
entries.summary: You draw out the warning shape of a curse, prophecy, inherited doom, or recurring disaster and make its next likely pressure point easier to recognize.

entries.name: Doom Knot
entries.summary: Bind a hostile curse, spirit, or fate-pattern into a temporary knot so it cannot act freely. Restrains a supernatural affliction long enough for escape or deeper work.

entries.name: Dormant Function
entries.summary: Identify the practical function hidden behind a relic appearance or ritual casing. Reveals what the object is meant to do if enough evidence remains.

entries.name: Double Release
entries.summary: Send two prepared thrown weapons into separate immediate problems in one practiced sequence, such as two targets or a target and a nearby mechanism. Both throws still need plausible range and lines.

entries.name: Doubtbreaker
entries.summary: You answer spiritual intimidation, blasphemous pressure, or corrupting temptation with practiced conviction. Use this to resist being shaken from a chosen belief or sacred duty without granting immunity to magic or persuasion.

entries.name: Draconic Mantle
entries.summary: You wrap yourself in a visible draconic manifestation of your established Type and Nature: scale-like defense, a fitting breath-aura, bodily reinforcement, territorial warning, or another coherent draconic expression. Use this to resist a fitting hazard, strengthen a draconic action, intimidate, shield, or draw dragon-sensitive attention without gaining unrestricted domain control.

entries.name: Dragon Breath Spark
entries.summary: You release a small draconic breath manifestation that expresses your established Type and Nature through a fitting substance or natural phenomenon. Use this to strike, mark, obscure, coat, chill, burn, shock, batter, or otherwise affect a nearby target only as that Nature plausibly allows; it does not grant independent control of the Nature's broader domain.

entries.name: Dragon Temper Reading
entries.summary: You read draconic signs well enough to judge mood, territory, age, likely response, and visible clues to a dragon's established Type and Nature. Use this to avoid provoking a dragon, interpret its behavior, or prepare for its presence.

entries.name: Dragon's Claim
entries.summary: You manifest your established Type and Nature at scene-changing scale through breath, scales, bodily reinforcement, movement, resistance, or draconic presence. The effect must remain explicitly draconic and does not grant command over dragons, independent control of the Nature's substance or phenomenon, or inherited territorial or pact rights.

entries.name: Dragonheart Reading
entries.summary: You read the deeper priorities behind a dragon's behavior: pride, territory, individual history, grievance, appetite, bargains, and any known Origin, State, or Condition that materially shapes the situation. Use this to choose a negotiating approach or predict how it may answer a meaningful provocation.

entries.name: Draining Touch
entries.summary: You channel death-state energy through touch, weapon contact, or close focus to sap vitality and weaken a living or undead target. Use this to exhaust a foe, feed a desperate spell, or disrupt unnatural life-force at close range.

entries.name: Dread Mandate
entries.summary: Rally or cow fear-sworn followers, shaken troops, desperate agents, or oath-bound subordinates through presence, reputation, and dread. Use this to restore order, halt a rout, secure attention, or demand a difficult action; loyalty, recognized authority, and consequences still determine whether they comply.

entries.name: Dreadfield
entries.summary: You flood the nearby area with supernatural dread, causing lesser threats to hesitate, scatter, freeze briefly, or fall back according to their own survival instincts. Disciplined or powerful targets may resist the pressure.

entries.name: Dream Entry
entries.summary: You observe the edge of a willing sleeper's dream or an established shared dream-space. Use this to witness symbols, repeated nightmares, dream-touched magic, or visible dream imagery without directly changing the dream.

entries.name: Dream Message
entries.summary: You place a short symbolic message into the dream of a willing sleeper or a target connected through an established consensual dream-link. The dreamer experiences it through their own imagery and may misunderstand symbolism.

entries.name: Dream Shape
entries.summary: You reshape an active dream-space by introducing symbolic scenery, sounds, warnings, comforts, or obstacles. Use this to communicate within a shared or willingly entered dream, calm a nightmare, or alter the dream environment while leaving the sleeper's waking state unchanged.

entries.name: Dream Ward
entries.summary: You reinforce a willing sleeper's dream or an established shared dream-space against hostile intrusion, recurring nightmare pressure, or destabilizing outside magic. The ward can shelter the dream, reveal interference, or help the sleeper wake cleanly.

entries.name: Dreamscape Command
entries.summary: You take structural control of an established shared or willingly entered dream-space for one intense scene, reshaping its rules, symbols, terrain, and atmosphere. Participants retain their own choices, and the effect does not alter their waking emotions, memories, or loyalties.

entries.name: Dungeon Pathbreak
entries.summary: You read airflow, dust, pressure marks, monster signs, and room logic to find the safest path through a dangerous structure. Use this to bypass obvious danger, identify a hidden route, or guide allies through a dungeon without triggering every threat.

entries.name: Dungeonmind
entries.summary: You read a dungeon, ruin, vault, or sealed structure as if its dangers are speaking through stone, dust, airflow, and silence. Use this to reveal hidden routes, predict layered traps, bypass deadly rooms, or guide allies through a complex dungeon safely.

entries.name: Dusk Throne
entries.summary: Your presence fills the nearby area with unstable dusk, deepening contrast and making your exact outline, approach, and position harder to read as radiance and shadow shift around you. Use this to control a close area through twilight obscurity and visual pressure; it does not command fear, loyalty, or obedience.

entries.name: Duskstep
entries.summary: You move through the boundary between light and shadow, becoming briefly difficult to target as your outline shifts between both. It works best where neither full brightness nor total darkness dominates.

entries.name: Dynastic Knot
entries.summary: You reconstruct a multi-generation web of inheritance, legitimization, wards, marriages, cadet branches, extinct lines, and competing jurisdictions to show how several claims interact. Use this to reveal a succession consequence capable of changing national politics without treating genealogy alone as legal judgment.

entries.name: Dynastic Leverage
entries.summary: Use inheritance concerns, family prestige, alliance expectations, or long-term house survival to pressure a negotiation without open threats. Establishes noble obligation or alliance pressure where lineage and inheritance matter.

entries.name: Earthen Wall
entries.summary: You raise, compact, or reshape earth and stone into a durable wall, ramp, brace, trench, or cover. Use this to block a charge, protect allies, seal a passage, stabilize rubble, or create a tactical barrier from the ground.

entries.name: Earthsplit Rescue Method
entries.summary: You move rubble, earth, timber, and stone with expert sequencing that preserves what must not collapse. Use this to rescue trapped people, open sealed paths, stabilize ruin damage, or clear heavy debris under danger.

entries.name: Echo Interrogation
entries.summary: Focus on one lingering impression and pose a narrow question through matching place, object, emotion, or magical trace. The echo may answer through fragment, sensation, voice, or symbol, but remains incomplete and cannot invent information it never contained.

entries.name: Echo Map
entries.summary: You use echoes, reverberation, and sound delay to estimate the size, openings, obstacles, and hidden spaces of an enclosed area you cannot fully see.

entries.name: Echo Replay
entries.summary: You draw a stronger echo into brief sensory replay: a sound, motion, phrase, emotional surge, spell-shape, or shadow of an event. Echoes are incomplete, symbolic, and can be distorted.

entries.name: Echo Sense
entries.summary: You notice when a place, object, wound, or spell carries an unusually strong lingering impression. It tells you an echo exists without revealing the full event.

entries.name: Echoing Enchantment
entries.summary: You make a prepared enchantment repeat its effect several times or persist through a demanding scene without constant attention. The effect must remain within the object or condition originally enchanted.

entries.name: Eclipse Edge
entries.summary: You combine radiance and shadow along one attack or cutting effect, letting it challenge defenses that rely entirely on either light or darkness.

entries.name: Eclipse Passage
entries.summary: Step through deep connected shadow in a way that feels impossible to witnesses. Enables a dramatic escape or entry through darkness when the scene supports supernatural movement.

entries.name: Eclipse Reversal
entries.summary: You vanish from the enemy's winning moment and reappear inside their failure. Use this after dodging, surviving, or reading a major attack to reverse momentum and punish the attacker with decisive force.

entries.name: Eclipse Turnabout
entries.summary: You erase the enemy's decisive moment and replace it with your own. Use this after surviving, dodging, blocking, or reading a devastating attack to reverse the scene and punish the attacker with legendary precision.

entries.name: Ecological Leverage
entries.summary: You identify one practical way to use a local ecosystem without destroying it, such as attracting or avoiding animals, finding water, controlling pests, or locating a renewable resource.

entries.name: Edge Line
entries.summary: You guide a bladed strike along the cleanest path instead of forcing power through bad angle. Use this with swords, daggers, axes, scythes, or other edged weapons to make a precise cut or punish an exposed guard.

entries.name: Edge Temper
entries.summary: You magically harden, straighten, or sharpen one metal tool, weapon, plate, or fitting for a short scene. It improves the object function without replacing skilled Smithing.

entries.name: Efficient Stroke
entries.summary: You maintain a sustainable swimming rhythm through distance, equipment drag, or mild current without exhausting yourself as quickly as an untrained swimmer.

entries.name: Eightfold Staffline
entries.summary: You anchor an entire melee around one staff line, redirecting charges, throws, missiles, and weapon paths through timing and leverage. Can hold a chokepoint or protect a fallen ally against overwhelming physical pressure.

entries.name: Elemental Companion
entries.summary: You summon and bind a sturdier companion, servant, or construct that can act during a full scene. Use this to fight, protect, scout, carry messages, or solve physical problems, but it remains limited by its nature and binding.

entries.name: Ember Renewal
entries.summary: You kindle a small phoenix-like flame in body, spirit, or object. Use this to steady someone after injury, burn away minor corruption, rekindle morale, cleanse a small taint, or keep a wounded person conscious long enough to act.

entries.name: Emberheart
entries.summary: You kindle a persistent reserve of phoenix vitality in yourself or one willing ally, allowing them to recover from one severe collapse during the scene if they are still alive.

entries.name: Emergency Antidote
entries.summary: You combine available ingredients into a targeted temporary antidote or symptom suppressant when the toxin or contaminant is understood well enough to treat.

entries.name: Emergency Bastion
entries.summary: You rapidly assemble nearby doors, furniture, planks, rope, cloth, leather, carts, and other workable material into temporary cover, a barricade, reinforced gear, or a protected work position. The result is improvised handwork for the immediate danger, not structural engineering or a load-bearing bridge.

entries.name: Emergency Dismount
entries.summary: Leave a moving, falling, panicked, or wounded mount in a controlled way that preserves a chance to land, roll, or reach cover. It reduces the danger of a bad mounted situation rather than cancelling it.

entries.name: Emergency Jury-Rig
entries.summary: Use ship structure and rigging knowledge to make one temporary repair or replacement that keeps a damaged vessel functional through the immediate hazard. It sacrifices durability for survival rather than restoring the ship completely.

entries.name: Emergency Triage
entries.summary: Sort multiple wounded people by urgency and act fast enough to save the one most likely to die first. Stabilizes the most critical patient and improves survival odds for the scene.

entries.name: Endless Star Throw
entries.summary: Your thrown weapons, tools, and improvised projectiles move through the scene like a planned constellation. Use this to strike multiple targets, interrupt spellcasting, disarm foes, punish pursuit, or attack from angles no one expected.

entries.name: Endstate
entries.summary: You focus on one already compromised target and force its accumulated fractures toward decisive failure. Against a truly sound target it has far less leverage; Ruin Arcana remains strongest where collapse has already begun.

entries.name: Endurance March
entries.summary: Sustain travel pace through fatigue, poor conditions, or extended distance without significant degradation. Passive; reduces the stamina cost of long travel and prevents exhaustion events.

entries.name: Entangle
entries.summary: You urge nearby plants, roots, vines, branches, or living wood to hinder a target. Use this to slow pursuit, bind limbs, create cover, or turn vegetation into a temporary obstacle.

entries.name: Equalizing Edge
entries.summary: Shape twilight into a balanced strike or ward that bites especially cleanly into effects relying on overwhelming radiance, consuming shadow, or one-sided magical extremes. It does not cancel unrelated magic and still requires a successful contest against powerful effects.

entries.name: Etching Touch
entries.summary: You draw a controlled caustic trace across a small surface. Use this to etch a mark, weaken a thin fastener, clean corrosion, or damage a fragile material without flooding the area.

entries.name: Etiquette Trap
entries.summary: Ask a formally correct question whose expected answer depends on status, precedent, procedure, or preparation. A revealing response can expose ignorance, false status, overreach, or weak preparation, but the ability does not read hidden intent or force someone to confess.

entries.name: Evasive Story
entries.summary: Avoid a cornering question or demand for impossible knowledge through parable, misdirection, changed audience, or incomplete truth. Deflects a cornering question or social trap through controlled misdirection.

entries.name: Evasive Turn
entries.summary: You execute an evasive maneuver that trades comfort for survival. Can dodge collision, hostile fire, reefs, debris, or sudden terrain when the craft can physically respond.

entries.name: Event Horizon
entries.summary: You create an extreme short-lived gravity boundary that bends trajectories and drags nearby matter toward a controlled center. It is broad, hazardous, and cannot safely distinguish allies from enemies inside the field.

entries.name: Event Reconstruction
entries.summary: You weave several compatible echoes into a coherent sequence of what likely occurred in a place. Missing or distorted impressions remain visible as uncertainty rather than being filled in automatically.

entries.name: Evidence Over Orders
entries.summary: Act decisively when confirmed evidence contradicts incomplete, misleading, or politically compromised orders. Permits decisive action when confirmed facts contradict compromised orders.

entries.name: Exact Deposition
entries.summary: You record testimony, sequence, names, qualifications, and uncertainty in a form that preserves what was actually said and makes later contradiction easier to detect.

entries.name: Exile Formula
entries.summary: Name the mismatch between an outsider and the world strongly enough to weaken its hold. Improves banishment, dismissal, or forced retreat against planar beings.

entries.name: Expedition Command Board
entries.summary: You turn a dangerous mission into roles, fallback plans, supply priorities, and hazard responses. Use this before a journey, dungeon run, monster hunt, sea voyage, or risky negotiation to reduce chaos for the whole group.

entries.name: Exploit Opening
entries.summary: Spot the moment when the enemy line, argument, pursuit, or defense has overextended and direct allies to act together. Turns one discovered weakness into group advantage.

entries.name: Eye of the Tempest
entries.summary: You seize command of an existing major storm for one decisive scene, bending its wind, rain, lightning, and pressure toward your intent. The storm remains dangerous, exhausting, and larger than the caster.

entries.name: Faction Etiquette
entries.summary: You recall a faction customary greeting, taboo, rank signal, bargaining habit, or internal courtesy well enough to avoid an obvious social mistake.

entries.name: Fair Price
entries.summary: Separate fair value from desperation, ignorance, or theater in a negotiation. Prevents ordinary overcharging or panic-selling from controlling the deal.

entries.name: Faith Under Pressure
entries.summary: Resist intimidation, despair, public panic, and moral pressure when others are watching for certainty. Maintains resolve when others are watching for certainty.

entries.name: Falling Star Impact
entries.summary: You focus stellar force into a visible point, releasing cold radiance, crushing light, and celestial shock. Use this to strike a major target, break a fortified position, scatter a formation, or reveal hidden supernatural structures.

entries.name: Falling Star Volley
entries.summary: You release several shots or projectiles in a controlled burst rather than a single attack. Use this to pressure multiple nearby targets, pin a group, punish a charge, or cover an ally's movement.

entries.name: False Hand
entries.summary: You chain misdirection, touch, and body angle so the audience remembers the wrong hand. Can steal or plant something on a guarded person if you first create social or physical cover.

entries.name: False Pattern
entries.summary: You lose or win in a pattern that changes how others read you. Lets you bait overconfidence, hide competence, or draw a specific opponent into a larger wager.

entries.name: False Trail Loop
entries.summary: You loop behind a search pattern and leave signs pointing the wrong way. Can break active pursuit if cover, crowd, terrain, or confusion gives you any opening.

entries.name: Famine Aura
entries.summary: You spread a draining pressure through an area that makes exertion feel costly and resources seem to vanish faster. It weakens sustained action rather than instantly starving anyone.

entries.name: Farsight
entries.summary: You remotely observe a known, visited, marked, or strongly connected place for a brief span. Use this to scout, verify danger, watch a ritual, or check on allies, but wards and sensitive targets may notice the observation.

entries.name: Fate's Wager
entries.summary: You make a high-stakes game feel like fate bending around your nerve and preparation. Can force a decisive social or financial outcome when all parties willingly remain at the table.

entries.name: Fatebreaker Moment
entries.summary: You challenge one apparently inevitable outcome and create a narrow alternative path where none seemed to remain. The new possibility still requires action, sacrifice, or success; Fate Arcana does not guarantee victory.

entries.name: Fated Crossroads
entries.summary: You force the scene toward a decisive turning point where choices, consequences, luck, and destiny converge. It does not guarantee victory; it makes the next choice matter more.

entries.name: Faultline Touch
entries.summary: You trace a physical object or structure by hand and identify a hidden crack, warped join, loose fitting, stress line, or concealed seam.

entries.name: Fearbreak
entries.summary: You break through the moment when fear would seize control of your next action. Use this to move, fight, speak, rescue, or decide under severe terror, including supernatural fear, while still respecting real danger.

entries.name: Fearsome Persona
entries.summary: Let reputation, costume, silence, and timing make an entrance feel larger than one person. Forces hesitation from enemies who believe the persona is dangerous.

entries.name: Feast Before the Impossible
entries.summary: You organize an extraordinary communal feast for a force, expedition, household, or battered company facing a legendary ordeal, using scarce ingredients and careful preparation to restore shared resolve and physical readiness. It cannot erase wounds or exhaustion that still require treatment and rest.

entries.name: Featherfall Field
entries.summary: You reduce effective weight across a small area enough to slow falls, ease lifting, or soften impacts for several people at once. It does not grant true flight.

entries.name: Fence Sense
entries.summary: You judge what kind of buyer, broker, or middleman would handle a suspicious good and what risks, questions, or proof they are likely to demand.

entries.name: Field Bridge
entries.summary: You design and direct a temporary crossing from rope, timber, carts, debris, or local structure that can safely carry a defined load if materials are adequate.

entries.name: Field Differential
entries.summary: Use symptoms together with local plants, animals, water, weather, and environmental signs to narrow several plausible causes of illness or injury into the most likely immediate treatment path. It remains a diagnosis, not certainty.

entries.name: Field Distillation
entries.summary: You improvise a controlled distillation, reduction, infusion, or separation with limited equipment to produce a useful extract, spirit, medicine base, or cleaner reagent.

entries.name: Field Dressing
entries.summary: Stabilize a bleeding, shocked, or collapsing person with fast practical care under pressure. Prevents an injury from immediately worsening if treatment is physically possible.

entries.name: Field Evidence Judgment
entries.summary: Compare orders, reports, doctrine, and visible evidence to identify contradictions before committing to action. Reveals contradictions between orders, reports, doctrine, and visible field evidence.

entries.name: Field Patch
entries.summary: You make a fast repair sturdy enough to survive the next problem. Use this to fix torn cloth, loose straps, cracked handles, damaged packs, simple tools, or field gear under pressure.

entries.name: Field Repair
entries.summary: Patch a damaged mechanism, bridge, tool, lock housing, armor joint, or vehicle enough to keep it working. Restores temporary function until proper repairs are possible.

entries.name: Final Benediction
entries.summary: Stand as the living focus of oath, mercy, and judgment in a decisive crisis, giving willing allies a clear example and words to rally around. Use this to steady ordinary fear and confront others with the moral weight of your vow; it creates no supernatural compulsion, ward, or holy attack.

entries.name: Final Exchange
entries.summary: Force a duel into one clear deciding moment where hesitation, poor footing, and false tempo are punished. Greatly improves the finishing exchange of a one-on-one fight.

entries.name: Final Opening
entries.summary: You read the finishing measure of a duel and strike through the one opening the opponent cannot close in time. Bypasses ordinary guard on a successful decisive exchange, but not supernatural protection.

entries.name: Find the Third Route
entries.summary: Identify a credible alternative passage when the obvious and known routes are blocked, provided the surrounding geography actually permits one. The route may still be dangerous, costly, or uncertain.

entries.name: Find the Unofficial Door
entries.summary: Identify the kind of local intermediary, worker, fixer, tavern contact, runner, or neighborhood figure most likely to reach a person or service outside official channels. The contact can still refuse or demand a price.

facts.label: Requirements
facts.value: Street Networker 1, Thieves' Lore 30, Social Inquiry 30

entries.name: Find the Weak Doctrine
entries.summary: Identify one assumption in an enemy plan, formation, patrol pattern, or defensive doctrine that can be exploited by a plausible counter-plan. It creates tactical leverage, not an automatic victory.

entries.name: Firestep
entries.summary: You burst heat and flame beneath or behind your movement for a sudden dash, leap, or evasive shift. It can cross a short hazard or punish pursuit but leaves obvious heat and ignition risk.

entries.name: Firestorm
entries.summary: You unleash a wide destructive storm of flame and heat that dominates a scene. Use this to devastate a position, cleanse corrupted growth, break formations, or reshape terrain, but it is obvious, dangerous, and hard to contain.

entries.name: First Aid Spark
entries.summary: You act quickly before a small injury becomes a serious problem. Use this to bind wounds, slow bleeding, clean an injury, steady breathing, or stabilize someone long enough for better care.

entries.name: First Shock
entries.summary: You steady your body against a first wave of nausea, pain, drink, smoke, heat, cold, or poison symptoms. Delays the immediate penalty long enough to act clearly.

entries.name: Flame Strike
entries.summary: You channel fire into a directed burst, blade, hand, or thrown line of heat. Use this to burn a target, ignite material, cauterize quickly, scare beasts, or destroy flammable obstacles.

entries.name: Flame's Defiance
entries.summary: You awaken the Flame within the Luporian medallion and deliberately act through fear, intimidation, despair, overwhelming odds, predatory presence, magical dread, humiliation, or other immediate pressure that would otherwise make you hesitate, retreat, submit, or lose your nerve. For this action, that pressure cannot prevent you from making the attempt, though the danger, disadvantage, and underlying pressure remain and can affect you again afterward. This does not make you fearless, remove tactical disadvantage, grant immunity to mental influence, or automatically make the chosen action succeed.

entries.name: Flash Flask
entries.summary: Create a sudden burst of smoke, light, stink, foam, heat, or irritant from carried reagents. Disrupts visibility, pursuit, or concentration in a small area.

entries.name: Flashfreeze
entries.summary: You drive cold into one target or tight area fast enough to seize joints, freeze liquid, lock a mechanism, or create brittle failure. The effect is focused and can be resisted by heat, insulation, or strong magic.

entries.name: Flood Surge
entries.summary: You call or redirect a powerful mass of water through a scene. Use this to break formations, extinguish fire, clear obstacles, move heavy objects, or reshape terrain where enough liquid exists or can be gathered.

entries.name: Focus Breaker
entries.summary: You send a shot into the eye-line, fingers, reins, or casting focus of a target. Can interrupt concentration, spoil aim, or force a target to guard their face and hands.

entries.name: Folded Bastion
entries.summary: You bend the paths around a protected position so attacks and movement must cross more distance than they appear to. It is broad defensive geometry rather than an impenetrable wall.

entries.name: Folded Escape Route
entries.summary: Prepare a short spatial return between your present position and one nearby visible or carefully marked point, allowing a rapid retreat or rescue through the fold once before it collapses. Wards, unknown barriers, and major spatial interference can block it.

entries.name: Follow the Flinch
entries.summary: Notice which subject, name, claim, or relationship produces the strongest involuntary reaction and pursue that thread through careful questioning. It identifies emotional pressure without reading minds or proving why the reaction exists.

entries.name: Forbidden Footnote
entries.summary: Recognize when a safe-looking source points toward censored, hidden, or dangerous knowledge. Opens a route toward deeper research while warning of risk.

entries.name: Forbidden Seal Recognition
entries.summary: You identify the immediate structure and danger of a curse, taboo rite, sealed name, corrupt enchantment, or forbidden symbol, including the safest obvious way to avoid completing or triggering it. It tells you what kind of danger you face, not every hidden layer.

entries.name: Forbidden Tingle
entries.summary: You feel when a symbol, phrase, object, or magical effect belongs to dangerous knowledge. Use this to notice taboo lore, unsafe rituals, cursed signs, or hidden corruption before touching deeper.

entries.name: Force Cascade
entries.summary: You release a heavy directional wave of kinetic force that throws bodies, breaks cover, scatters objects, and can crack weak structures. Use this to clear a path, smash a formation, interrupt a charge, or weaponize debris.

entries.name: Force Hold
entries.summary: You lock invisible pressure around a target, limb, weapon, doorway, or moving object for a short time. The hold requires focus and can be broken by strength, magic, leverage, or damage.

entries.name: Force Push
entries.summary: You strike a nearby target, object, door, weapon, or incoming threat with invisible kinetic force. Use this to shove, stagger, interrupt, deflect, knock loose, or create space at short range.

entries.name: Force Screen
entries.summary: You maintain a flat or angled plane of invisible force that catches one direction of projectiles, impacts, or movement. It is stronger when braced against a clear line of attack.

entries.name: Forest Wrath
entries.summary: You awaken hostile plant growth across a scene, making roots, branches, thorns, and living wood attack, bind, shield, or reshape the battlefield. The effect is strongest in forests, gardens, ruins overgrown by nature, or places with deep roots.

entries.name: Forgeguard Temper
entries.summary: You restore or strengthen metalwork so it can survive punishment beyond normal repair. Use this to reinforce armor, repair weapons, stabilize damaged tools, or prepare metal gear for a dangerous scene.

entries.name: Forked Omen
entries.summary: You read several plausible near-future branches around one declared choice. The vision highlights dangers and turning points rather than revealing a guaranteed future.

entries.name: Formal Draft
entries.summary: You turn rough intent into a clear letter, petition, report, order, contract draft, or notice in an appropriate formal structure without inventing authority.

entries.name: Formal Hand
entries.summary: You reproduce a formal hand, seal-adjacent layout, or official style well enough to pass procedural review. Can make a document look institutionally proper without forging authority that was never earned.

entries.name: Fortress
entries.summary: You raise a powerful protective field that makes a position difficult to breach for one major scene. Use this to shelter allies, hold a chokepoint, resist a ritual backlash, or survive overwhelming supernatural pressure.

entries.name: Fortress Camp Doctrine
entries.summary: You arrange a temporary camp like a small fortress of watchlines, supply protection, recovery space, and morale. Use this to protect a group from ambush, bad weather, exhaustion, night monsters, or travel collapse.

entries.name: Fortunate Turn
entries.summary: You tug on probability around one immediate action, creating a narrow lucky opening or forcing an enemy good fortune to stumble. Use this to turn a near miss into a chance, make a risky move barely work, or spoil enemy timing.

entries.name: Fortune Engine
entries.summary: Turn contacts, timing, goods, favors, and risk into a major opportunity others cannot easily copy. Creates a large commercial advantage if the region has enough trade to support it.

entries.name: Fortune Reversal
entries.summary: You restructure a failing high-stakes trade or supply situation across several parties, turning liabilities, timing, substitute goods, credit, and competing needs into a viable new arrangement. Use this to reverse a commercial disaster whose solution requires more than bargaining over one price.

entries.name: Freshness Read
entries.summary: You judge whether blood, smoke, food, sweat, spoor, rot, perfume, or another scent is fresh, stale, diluted, or recently disturbed.

entries.name: Frost Bite
entries.summary: You project focused cold onto a target, surface, weapon, or patch of terrain. Use this to slow limbs, glaze footing, numb exposed flesh, preserve something briefly, or weaken heat-based effects.

entries.name: Frost Sheath
entries.summary: You wrap an object, weapon, limb, or small surface in controlled frost. Use this to cool heat, stiffen material, numb contact, preserve something, or make a held edge dangerously cold.

entries.name: Fullmoon Revelation
entries.summary: You flood a major scene with silver lunar force that exposes hidden transformations, buried instincts, glamours, and suppressed truths while strengthening phase-driven Moon magic.

entries.name: Funeral Sense
entries.summary: Recognize when a death, haunting, shrine, grave, or memorial has been handled wrongly. Reveals the immediate spiritual offense or unfinished duty.

entries.name: Gale Step
entries.summary: You ride controlled air around your body, weapon, or path for a short movement advantage. Use this to leap farther, slow a fall, cross unstable footing, redirect projectiles, or move through a tight battlefield opening.

entries.name: Gate Across Distance
entries.summary: You open a temporary passage to a distant location that is known, prepared, strongly attuned, or visibly connected through a valid anchor. Unknown or heavily warded destinations remain unsafe or unreachable.

entries.name: Gate's Challenge
entries.summary: You awaken the Gate within the Luporian medallion and deliberately take control of a nearby doorway, bridge, stair, narrow passage, or other clear threshold for the present action. Use this to bar ordinary passage through that point, forcing anyone who tries to cross while you hold it to overcome, displace, evade, or otherwise deal with you rather than simply moving past. It does not make you immovable, stop ranged attacks, prevent magical passage, or control a threshold too broad for you to meaningfully guard.

entries.name: Gatewright
entries.summary: Understand a major crossing well enough to open, close, redirect, or survive it under extreme pressure. Enables one decisive intervention at a planar gate or boundary.

entries.name: Gatherer's Sweep
entries.summary: You search an area in a practical pattern instead of wandering randomly. Use this to find edible plants, herbs, dry fuel, clean water signs, useful scraps, or simple natural materials.

entries.name: Ghost Key
entries.summary: You create a temporary working key from memory, tension, and improvised material after reading the mechanism. Allows repeated access to one lock for a short period without breaking it.

entries.name: Ghost Step
entries.summary: Move through a tense area while matching noise, shadow, crowd flow, or patrol rhythm. Bypasses ordinary watchers when no direct magical detection is involved.

entries.name: Giantfall Stone
entries.summary: You launch a single impossible stone into the exact weak point of giant, machine, siege gear, or monster. Can topple, crack, or disable something far larger than the projectile should affect.

entries.name: Glacial Dominion
entries.summary: You drop the temperature across a dangerous scene until surfaces freeze, movement slows, and unprotected targets suffer sustained cold pressure. Use this to lock terrain, isolate enemies, protect an area, or turn the environment itself against a threat.

entries.name: Glass Gleam
entries.summary: You read and shape small glass details: stress lines, reflections, clarity, hidden flaws, cutting edges, and trapped light. Use this to detect tampered glass, improve a lens, create a shard, or expose a hidden watcher.

entries.name: Glass Needle
entries.summary: You draw nearby glass into one thin controlled shard or cutting filament. Use it for a precise attack, surgical cut, lock manipulation, or delicate material work.

entries.name: Glass Shardweave
entries.summary: You shape glass into temporary blades, screens, lenses, mirrors, bindings, or fragile barriers. Use this to cut, deflect, hide, focus light, scatter sightlines, or create a dangerous obstacle.

entries.name: Glassstorm
entries.summary: You suspend and drive a broad cloud of glass fragments through controlled currents, creating lethal area denial and moving cover. The storm threatens allies and unprotected surroundings as readily as enemies.

entries.name: Gloom Step
entries.summary: Move between patches of shadow as if the darkness briefly covers the transition. Enables a short hidden reposition where the lighting supports it.

entries.name: Golden Deadlock
entries.summary: You restructure a stalled negotiation by trading secondary concessions, timing, guarantees, and competing interests until each side has a reason to move. Use this to break a serious deadlock where a single better offer would not be enough.

entries.name: Graceful Entry
entries.summary: Enter a formal room, audience, feast, or negotiation without giving offense and with enough poise to be heard. Prevents immediate social dismissal in polite company.

entries.name: Grand Array
entries.summary: You construct a large interlocking runic system that governs an area, ritual, fortification, or complex magical process. It can combine multiple conditions and effects, but requires time, layout, and stable anchors.

entries.name: Grand Expedition Doctrine
entries.summary: You transform a dangerous journey into a master plan of roles, resources, routes, hazards, fallback options, and victory conditions. Use this to prepare a group for a major expedition, ruin delve, monster hunt, military march, or sea voyage.

entries.name: Grand Gate Summons
entries.summary: You open a major conduit for one powerful summoned entity, construct, or force whose nature you understand. The arrival can reshape a scene, but bargaining, binding limits, and consequences remain real.

entries.name: Grasping Ground
entries.summary: You buckle, ridge, or clutch the ground beneath a small cluster of targets. It can catch feet, spoil a charge, create rough cover, or hold a position without collapsing the whole area.

entries.name: Grave Chain
entries.summary: You bind death-state energy around one spirit, corpse, undead target, or dying threshold. Use this to restrain unnatural movement, interrupt necromantic control, or keep a deathly presence from crossing a boundary.

entries.name: Gravity Pulse
entries.summary: You release a pulse of altered gravity that pulls, shoves, drops, or lifts everything in a small area. Use this to knock enemies off balance, drag targets from cover, break a charge, scatter loose objects, or create an opening.

entries.name: Gravity Shift
entries.summary: You locally increase, decrease, or tilt gravity around yourself, a small object, a falling body, or a nearby point. Use this to slow a fall, lighten a load, pin a loose object, pull something into reach, or make movement briefly strange.

entries.name: Gravity Well
entries.summary: You create a strong localized pull around one chosen point, dragging loose objects and contested targets toward it. Anchoring, distance, and opposing force matter.

entries.name: Greater Conjuration
entries.summary: You open a powerful conduit and call a significant entity, construct, or force into the scene. Use this to change a battle, bargain with a summoned presence, create a major helper, or answer an extraordinary threat, but the binding must be respected.

entries.name: Greenway
entries.summary: You bend vegetation aside and regrow it behind a moving group, creating a temporary hidden route through dense woodland, hedges, or overgrowth without permanently clearing the land.

entries.name: Grounding Bind
entries.summary: You bind weapon, limb, shield, or beast muzzle between staff and ground, using leverage to control a stronger opponent. Can immobilize one point of a target without matching raw strength.

entries.name: Guard Cut
entries.summary: Cut into an enemy weapon line as it forms rather than after it lands. Disrupts a straightforward melee attack and creates room for a counterstroke.

entries.name: Guard Splitter
entries.summary: You split guard, shield rim, weapon haft, or armor posture with a committed chopping line. Can break a defensive object or stance when the material can plausibly give.

entries.name: Guarded Casting
entries.summary: Keep breath, stance, and guard intact while using magic under threat. Prevents ordinary melee pressure from immediately breaking a simple magical action.

entries.name: Guarded Triage
entries.summary: Use a shielded position and healing magic together to stabilize someone who is still inside immediate danger. It creates a short treatment window under pressure rather than making the patient or healer immune to attack.

entries.name: Guardian Last Line
entries.summary: You anchor a group defense around yourself so nearby allies can fall back, recover, or act behind your protection. The effect holds many directions but ties you to the defended position.

entries.name: Guardian Share
entries.summary: You accept part of the pressure aimed at a nearby ally, extending your protective magic to split an incoming threat between defended positions.

entries.name: Guardian's Refusal
entries.summary: Interpose absolute guardian force between one threatened ally and a devastating incoming harm, taking the burden onto the ward and refusing displacement long enough to preserve a chance of survival. It does not negate consequences without limit and can be broken by overwhelming power.

entries.name: Guarding Reach
entries.summary: You command a broad zone with point, hook, butt, and blade, protecting allies behind you. Can hold a line against several physical attackers if the terrain supports reach.

entries.name: Guildhall Arbitration
entries.summary: You arbitrate a major professional dispute by reconciling craft standards, guild privileges, workshop evidence, fees, apprenticeships, and competing claims. Use this to expose institutional fraud or produce a ruling framework experts must seriously answer, without granting yourself an office you do not hold.

entries.name: Guildhall Measure
entries.summary: You judge professional authority, workmanship, fees, claims, workshop practice, and guild custom well enough to tell who is competent, who is overreaching, and which standard actually applies. Use this to secure cooperation or challenge bad professional practice with recognized grounds.

entries.name: Half-Sword Bind
entries.summary: You shorten your grip on a large blade to gain leverage and point control in close quarters, allowing binds, armored thrusts, or safer work inside normal cutting distance.

entries.name: Hall of Mirrors
entries.summary: You connect several nearby reflective surfaces into a confusing network of sightlines and false positions. Observers may see targets from the wrong angle or lose track of the real path.

entries.name: Hammer Rhythm
entries.summary: You hammer rhythm into a target until guard, stance, and breathing fall out of sync. Creates an opening against heavily armored or braced opponents.

entries.name: Hand Trap
entries.summary: You catch a wrist, forearm, collar, or weapon hand during close contact and turn the grip into a brief control position instead of trading another strike.

entries.name: Harbor Command
entries.summary: Take control of dock crews, ship guards, boat hands, riverfolk, or port workers during weather, evacuation, sabotage, or harbor panic. Creates emergency control over crews, dockworkers, vessels, or port movement.

entries.name: Hard-Won Mercy
entries.summary: Protect locals, workers, crews, or stranded travelers fiercely while demanding honest answers in return. Protects endangered locals or travelers while demanding honesty in return.

entries.name: Harmonic Diagnosis
entries.summary: You analyze resonance, tuning, echo, and repeating tones to locate a hidden source, unstable instrument, structural vibration, or magical harmonic fault.

entries.name: Harrying Throw
entries.summary: Throw to spoil balance, vision, grip, or pursuit instead of simply wounding. Slows or disrupts one enemy long enough to reposition.

entries.name: Haunting Accord
entries.summary: Establish a temporary, clearly bounded accord with a present spirit, haunting, ancestor echo, or local presence, defining one question, task, boundary, or period of non-hostility. The spirit retains agency and can demand terms or refuse.

entries.name: Hazard Map
entries.summary: You mark likely choke points, flood paths, ambush ground, unstable slopes, exposed crossings, and safer alternatives on a working map for a group.

entries.name: Healing Thread
entries.summary: You guide restorative power through a wound, bruise, fever, toxin symptom, or exhausted body without wasting energy. Use this to stabilize someone, close minor harm, or prevent an injury from worsening.

entries.name: Heart Against Heaven
entries.summary: You face a presence or crisis that could make lesser people abandon reason and still retain the freedom to choose your response. Use this against legendary terror, catastrophic pressure, or impossible odds; courage lets you act, not ignore consequences.

entries.name: Heartbeat Tell
entries.summary: At close range and under workable conditions, you distinguish breath and heartbeat changes that reveal exertion, fear, pain, or concealed presence without reading thoughts.

entries.name: Heartglass Chorus
entries.summary: You read the emotional current of a crowd, court, council, or faction gathering as a connected system, identifying coordinated manipulation, hidden blocs, contagious fear, and the points where collective mood may turn. Individual secrets still require individual evidence.

entries.name: Heartglass Deep Read
entries.summary: You map the conflicting fears, loyalties, desires, guilt, and influence inside a small group, revealing who is driving whom and which relationship is most likely to break first. Use this to understand the social structure beneath the spoken argument.

entries.name: Heartglass Revelation
entries.summary: You identify the central emotion or concealed motive shaping one person’s behavior in the present scene and distinguish it from the mask they are presenting. Use this to choose a better question, warning, reassurance, or pressure point without reading thoughts.

entries.name: Hearth's Respite
entries.summary: You awaken the Hearth within the Luporian medallion and give one nearby willing person a brief supernatural moment of relief amid danger or exhaustion. For their next immediate action, pain, fatigue, fear, shock, or similar strain that would hinder them is held at bay enough for them to act clearly and effectively. This does not heal injuries, restore spent resources, cure conditions, or remove the underlying strain, which returns afterward.

entries.name: Heartline Shot
entries.summary: Read breath, armor gaps, movement, and fear to place one decisive arrow. Bypasses ordinary armor on a clean hit but not full supernatural protection.

entries.name: Heat Map
entries.summary: You estimate where guards, investigators, gangs, informants, and frightened associates are likely to concentrate after a crime or scandal, helping plan safer movement.

entries.name: Heat Without Ruin
entries.summary: Apply magical heat with a smith's control to soften, join, cauterize, or work a precise part of a metal object without flooding the whole area with flame. Proper material, tools, and structure still matter.

entries.name: Heaven-Splitting Sequence
entries.summary: You unleash a legendary chain of Dueling-family weapon attacks, movement, feints, parries, and ripostes that turns one opening into a battle-deciding sequence. Use this to overwhelm a powerful opponent or cut through several nearby threats; other weapon families and unarmed attacks remain governed by their own skills.

entries.name: Heavenbolt
entries.summary: You gather an extreme electrical charge into one precisely chosen strike from sky, focus, or conductive path. It is a narrow legendary attack with very high Power, but requires a viable line and produces enormous noise and collateral risk.

entries.name: Heavy Beat
entries.summary: You let weight and timing do the work instead of swinging wildly. Use this with hammers, maces, axes, clubs, or heavy weapons to stagger armor, break posture, or make a slow strike count.

entries.name: Heraldic Challenge
entries.summary: Invoke formal heraldic protocol to challenge, announce, or establish the standing of a person or party. Creates a socially binding formal moment.

entries.name: Hero's Banquet Aura
entries.summary: You prepare a substantial meal whose timing, nutrition, familiarity, and presentation restore morale and support recovery across a weary group. Use this before or after a major ordeal to reduce exhaustion, steady nerves, and help people recover together when ingredients and preparation time exist.

entries.name: Hero's Table
entries.summary: You prepare a meal that restores spirit as much as strength. Use this to improve group morale, support recovery, reduce exhaustion, calm nerves, or prepare allies before a dangerous scene.

entries.name: Heroic Radiance
entries.summary: You draw heroic resolve into a visible champion's radiance that can manifest as dawn-bright, dusk-bright, silver, ember, shadow-edged, or otherwise personal heroic force. Use this to shield allies, defy fear or corruption, answer hostile magic, or become the focus of a decisive stand.

entries.name: Heroic Refrain
entries.summary: Turn an ally recent effort into a shared refrain that reminds the group what they are fighting for. Restores resolve and strengthens a coordinated push.

entries.name: Hex Gesture
entries.summary: Use word, glare, knot, mark, or small ritual to burden a target with doubt, clumsiness, dread, or hesitation. Inflicts a brief misfortune if the target is vulnerable to uncanny pressure.

entries.name: Hidden Cost
entries.summary: Find the obligation, delay, reputation risk, or future favor hidden inside a good offer. Reveals what the deal will really cost beyond coin.

entries.name: Hidden Draw
entries.summary: Bring a small blade into position before the target realizes danger has begun. Enables a sudden close strike from concealment or distraction.

entries.name: Hidden Hand
entries.summary: You identify the habits of a particular encoder or institution from punctuation, grouping, errors, and favored transformations, helping link anonymous coded material to a source.

entries.name: Hidden Harvest
entries.summary: You uncover rare or abundant natural resources where others see scarcity. Use this to gather special herbs, emergency food, clean water signs, useful fibers, fuel, or natural materials enough to change a survival scene.

entries.name: Hidden Passage
entries.summary: Find and use the overlooked gap in a guarded route, crowd, camp, or building. Creates an infiltration path where ordinary eyes assume none exists.

entries.name: Hidden Pattern Thesis
entries.summary: Connect separated witness accounts, rumors, motives, relationships, and contradictions into one actionable theory before others see the social pattern. Reveals the most likely hidden structure supported by what people have said and how their accounts connect, not facts available only from records or physical evidence.

entries.name: Hidden Principle
entries.summary: Recognize the hidden principle behind a complex magical working and name the point where it can be changed. Opens a path to alter, stabilize, or dismantle major magic.

entries.name: Hidden Road
entries.summary: You reconstruct a concealed or forgotten route from terrain, weather, old roads, stars, water, and travel logic when ordinary navigation fails. Use this to find a credible passage through hostile or misleading country, though the route may remain dangerous or damaged.

entries.name: Hidden Route Synthesis
entries.summary: You turn incomplete maps, old routes, ruins, terrain logic, and landmark patterns into a strategic travel advantage. Use this to reveal hidden routes, expose false maps, plan ambush-safe movement, or redraw a region's practical routes.

entries.name: Hidden Stroke
entries.summary: You hide a small message, warning, count, or correction inside ornament, margin, stroke order, or spacing. Lets an intended reader find meaning while casual readers see decoration.

entries.name: Hidden Trail Reading
entries.summary: Read recent passage through disturbed moss, bark marks, scent, broken undergrowth, dust, water, or patrol signs even when tracks were hidden. Reveals recent passage even when tracks were partly concealed.

entries.name: Hoard Reading
entries.summary: Understand what a treasure, relic, memory, or captive means to a dragon or dragon-touched power. Reveals leverage beyond simple value.

entries.name: Hold Fast
entries.summary: Name the danger and give allies a simple reason not to break. Resists panic, hesitation, or disorder among willing followers.

entries.name: Hold the Gate
entries.summary: Organize workers, guards, allies, or bystanders to brace a doorway, bridge, tunnel, barricade, or choke point under pressure. Turns available people and material into a braced choke point or barricade.

entries.name: Hold the Room
entries.summary: Keep an audience focused through interruption, unease, or competing attention long enough to land one message, cue an ally, or finish a crucial performance beat. It commands attention, not obedience.

entries.name: Hook and Hew
entries.summary: Catch a shield, weapon, limb, or obstacle with the axe profile and use the opening to pull it off line before striking or repositioning. The technique creates leverage rather than automatic disarmament.

entries.name: Hook and Wedge
entries.summary: You use the axe as both hook and wedge, dragging an enemy off balance before the next blow falls. Forces a choice between losing position, shield, or weapon control.

entries.name: Hooked Guard
entries.summary: You use hook, haft, head, or reach to catch a limb, shield, weapon, or obstacle and deny an approach without needing a full strike.

entries.name: Hooking Axe
entries.summary: You hook with beard, haft, or blade edge to pull shield, ankle, rein, or weapon out of line. Creates an opening by moving the target rather than only cutting them.

entries.name: Hooking Sweep
entries.summary: You sweep hook, blade, and haft through legs, shields, reins, or weapon shafts. Can trip, drag, or pull an enemy out of formation at reach.

entries.name: Horizon Eye
entries.summary: You resolve tiny but physically visible details at extraordinary distance or through brief openings, provided light, line of sight, and scale still make observation possible.

entries.name: Horizon Leap
entries.summary: You make a legendary leap that turns distance, height, and danger into drama rather than impossibility. Can reach a critical target, rescue, ledge, or opening when the route is barely physically plausible.

entries.name: Horizon Scry
entries.summary: You extend magical perception toward a distant known place, person, or strongly attuned target with exceptional clarity. Powerful wards, false identities, planar barriers, or deliberate concealment can distort or block the view.

entries.name: Host of the Unseen
entries.summary: You call a broad assembly of nearby spirits into visible or tangible cooperation for one major scene. They may guard, reveal, carry messages, or oppose hostile spirits, but they remain beings with motives rather than disposable summons.

entries.name: Hostile-Field Engineering
entries.summary: Build or repair a complex device in hostile conditions by prioritizing function over elegance. Produces reliable temporary machinery from imperfect parts.

entries.name: House Survival Instinct
entries.summary: You recognize the exact moment a noble household is in danger and act before reputation, leverage, or safety collapses. Use this to spot court traps, protect family interests, redirect scandal, choose the safest ally, or preserve influence during a crisis.

entries.name: Household Command
entries.summary: Direct servants, guards, guests, lesser kin, retainers, or household staff inside a domain where the character has recognized authority. Creates command authority inside a household, estate, ship, company, or controlled domain.

entries.name: Hunger Draw
entries.summary: You sense need, craving, weakness, or draining pressure in a nearby creature, object, or scene. Use this to identify hunger, desperation, predatory intent, depleted reserves, or a vulnerable source of strength that could be pressured, fed, protected, or restored.

entries.name: Hunger Leash
entries.summary: You seize the shape of hunger in a target or scene and pull it into focus. Use this to intensify need, suppress a dangerous appetite, draw attention toward bait, weaken a creature already acting from desperation, or redirect draining pressure away from an ally.

entries.name: Hunt Ends Here
entries.summary: Drive a pursued target into a chosen dead end, exposed path, or forced confrontation by reading their habits and escape logic. Prevents ordinary flight from continuing unless the target has exceptional help or magic.

entries.name: Hurricane Eye
entries.summary: You create a localized eye of violent wind that bends movement, sightlines, missiles, and footing around you. Use this to control a battlefield lane, shield allies from ranged fire, scatter enemies, or reshape a dangerous scene with sustained air pressure.

entries.name: Hydraulic Grasp
entries.summary: You coil water around one target or object with focused pressure, pulling, pinning, turning, or crushing according to available liquid. Strong anchors or lack of water limit the effect.
